test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Taste of your own medicine

options.text: Have the same bad treatment that you have given to others
Try to manage something which went wrong
Extremely pleased and excited about something

solution:
The correct answer is **"Have the same bad treatment that you have given to others."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The idiom **'Taste of your own medicine' **implies that one gets treated the same way they have treated others, particularly in a negative way.
 
• **"Have the same bad treatment that you have given to others" -** This phrase succinctly captures the essence of the idiom **'Taste of your own medicine.' **
 
• It refers to experiencing the unpleasant consequences or outcomes that one has previously inflicted on others.
 
• Thus, it is the most accurate interpretation for the idiom 'Taste of your own medicine.'

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**
